name: Ami Bera
stance: A co-leader on international AI-safety diplomacy — shared safety standards and red lines with China and a crisis-communications channel.

statements.text: Joined more than 100 colleagues urging Speaker Johnson to keep the House in session to address AI risks.

Co-led a letter of 26 Democrats urging AI-safety diplomacy with China — shared safety standards and red lines, a crisis channel, and limits on proliferation of advanced AI, citing catastrophic risks like AI-enabled pathogens and cyberattacks.
Led a letter with Reps. Gregory Meeks and Sara Jacobs, signed by 26 Democrats, urging administration officials to open sustained dialogue with China on AI safety risks.
The United States and China need reliable crisis communication channels and serious dialogue on AI guardrails before a mistake like this becomes a disaster.

At the same time, the President should seek agreement on implementing AI guardrails and establishing reliable channels of communication that reduce the risk of miscalculation and provide mechanisms to deconflict during a crisis.

review.note: added October 2026; record verified via the co-leads' primary release
